name: @pipeworx/mcp-timestamp

tools.name: from_timestamp
tools.description: Convert a Unix timestamp to an ISO-8601 UTC date + human forms. Auto-detects seconds vs milliseconds by magnitude (override with `unit`). Keyless, offline.

tools.name: to_timestamp
tools.description: Convert an ISO-8601 (or other parseable) date string to a Unix timestamp (seconds + milliseconds). Keyless, offline.

tools.name: now
tools.description: The current UTC time as ISO-8601 and Unix timestamp (seconds + milliseconds).

tools.name: relative_time
tools.description: Humanize a date/time relative to now (or a given `from`): "2 hours ago", "in 3 days". Keyless, offline.

date.description: The target date/time (ISO-8601 or Unix timestamp).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-timestamp forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the timestamp pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
